text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan
Labuan (Pemerluasan dan Ubah Suaian Kanun Tanah Negara) (Pindaan) 2013.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Julai 2013.

Pindaan Jadual
Jadual kepada Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan (Pemerluasan dan Ubah Suaian
Kanun Tanah Negara) 2009 [ P.U. (A) 454/2009], dipinda dalam ubah suaian
seksyen 12—

(a) dengan menggantikan subseksyen (1) dengan subseksyen yang berikut:

      "(1)    There shall be established a Land Executive Committee for the
Federal Territory of Labuan consisting of—

(a) the Chief Secretary to the Government who shall be the
Chairman;

(b) the Secretary General of the Ministry of Federal
Territories who shall be the Deputy Chairman;

(c)    the Attorney General or his representative;

(d) the Secretary General of Treasury or the Deputy Secretary
General of Treasury as his alternate;

(e)    the Director General of Lands and Mines;

(f) the Senior Deputy Secretary General of the Prim e
Minister's Department; and

(g) the Chief Executive Officer of the Perbadanan Labuan
appointed under section 10 of the Perbadanan Labuan Act
2001 [Act 609]."; dan

      (b)  dengan menggantikan subseksyen (1A) dengan subseksyen yang berikut:

      "(1A)     The quorum of the Land Executive Committee shall be its
Chairman and a majority of its other members mentioned in
subsection (1).".

Dibuat 11 Julai 2013
[PN(SU. 2)1/EXT/KTN/5665/KLPL; KWP(S): 24/PUU/698/1/3/15; PN(PU2)415/XIV]

Dengan Titah Perintah

TAN SRI DR. ALI BIN HAMSA
Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ACT 1984

FEDERAL TERRITORY OF LABUAN (EXTENSION AND MODIFICATION OF NATIONAL
LAND CODE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section  7 of the Constitution (Amendment )
(No. 2) Act 1984 [Act A585], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the  Federal Territory of Labuan (Extension
and Modification of National Land Code) (Amendment) Order 2013.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 July 2013.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The Schedule to the Federal Territory of Labuan (Extension and Modification of
National Land Code) Order 2009 [P.U. (A) 454/2009], is amended in the modification of
section 12—

(a)  by substituting  for subsection (1) the following subsection:

     "(1)      There shall be established a Land Executive Committee for the
Federal Territory of Labuan consisting of—

(a) the Chief Secretary to the Government who shall be the
Chairman;

(b) the Secretary General of the Ministry of Federal Territories
who shall be the Deputy Chairman;

(c) the Attorney General or his representative;

(d) the Secretary General of Treasury or the Deputy Secretary
General of Treasury as his alternate;

(e) the Director General of Lands and Mines;

(f) the Senior Deputy Secretary General of the Prime Min ister's
Department; and

(g) the Chief Executive Officer of the Perbadanan Labuan
appointed under section 10 of the Perbadanan Labuan Act
2001 [Act 609]."; and

      (b)  by substituting for subsection  (1A) the following subsection:

    "(1A)   The quorum o f the Land Executive Committee shall be its
Chairman and a majority of its other members mentioned in
subsection (1).".

Made 11 July 2013
[PN(SU. 2)1/EXT/KTN/5665/KLPL; KWP(S): 24/PUU/698/1/3/15; PN(PU2)415/XIV]

By Command

TAN SRI DR. ALI BIN HAMSA
Secretary to the Cabinet
